history.summary: Freehold 3BR (1023 sqft) in D15 at $1.69M / $1652 PSF, an attractive quantum, but Fruition is a tiny boutique block with only 3 URA transactions and an 11-min/940m walk to Eunos MRT. Thin data and illiquidity make this hard to rate with conviction.
history.rating_rationale: $1.69M / $1652 PSF freehold in D15 is in a liquid quantum band and the East Coast location is desirable, but with only 3 URA txns and no median PSF, appreciation and exit liquidity are unverifiable. Boutique scale (few units), no MRT-on-doorstep (940m to Eunos), and no specific catalyst keep this at Neutral — the price is the main draw, not the fundamentals.
red_flags: Only 3 URA transactions — appreciation and fair value unverifiable
Small boutique development — limited resale liquidity and amenities
940m / 11-min walk to Eunos MRT — weak transit access
catalysts: Freehold tenure in deep-buyer-pool D15 East Coast
Sub-$1.7M quantum keeps the unit broadly affordable

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Moderate. D15 has solid tenant demand, but distance from MRT and boutique profile limit pull; a freehold 3BR suits families more than the transient rental market.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Cannot be quantified — 3 txns is statistically meaningless. D15 freehold should at least hold value, but boutique illiquidity is a real drag; assume RCR-baseline at best.
